scope: Isolated local Go server; synthetic credentials and diary; no external identity provider

checks.name: Password mismatch remains in the form; guest history is unchanged
Registration at 320/390/1440px: no overflow, labelled inputs and 44px password controls
Registration claims the real guest diary and provides a downloadable recovery code
The previous guest cookie cannot access the claimed diary
A separate browser signs in to the same saved diary; wrong password is rejected
Ending other sessions revokes server access and clears stale private UI on reload
Recovery rotates the code, revokes old sessions and preserves the diary
A consumed recovery code cannot be reused
Changing the password rotates the current session and revokes every old session
Logout revokes the saved bearer token and opens an empty guest space
Signing back in after logout restores the complete diary
Nutrition reloads after logout and login without leaving the current screen
